entradas.pregunta: What is Satronho NX for Android?
entradas.respuesta: Satronho NX is Riddsc's Switch emulator, now on Android too. It starts from Eden and Lichii, which we picked and optimized, and adds features of its own: Prepare game, suggested settings for your phone, the Satronho meter, the session summary and history, the news, and us, the guides. It needs Android 13 or newer and an ARM64 processor.

entradas.pregunta: Who are the guides and how do I ask them?
entradas.respuesta: We are MechaRidds and his pets Samy, Troya, Ñoño and Juana. We live in the bubble in the corner of the games list: tap it, write your question in your own words and we answer from what we know about Satronho NX, no internet needed. Each of us has a topic: Samy the features, Troya graphics and your sessions, Ñoño the settings and Juana the updates. Satronho → Guides introduces all five of us.

entradas.pregunta: How do I turn the guides off or back on?
entradas.respuesta: In the bubble, Turn off guides turns all of us off. To see us again: Settings → Guides. To turn off just one pet, go to Satronho → Guides tab and switch it off; MechaRidds answers for it.

entradas.pregunta: What does Prepare game do?
entradas.respuesta: It is a Satronho NX feature of its own. The first time you open a game, Samy offers to prepare it; later you find it on the game's page (long-press it) → Prepare game. Satronho takes the shaders out of the game's files now, and the next time you open it the loading screen builds them all with your phone's driver. That way it doesn't freeze when a shader shows up for the first time. On a phone it matters even more than on PC, because building shaders is much slower. A prepared game has a ✓ on its card. If the game keeps no shaders to take out ahead (like Celeste), I tell you and don't give it a ✓: the cache keeps those while you play.

entradas.pregunta: What does the Satronho meter show?
entradas.respuesta: In the game, at the top, the meter shows: FPS (green when fine, amber when it drops, red when it is very slow), each frame's time in milliseconds, the stutters (frames over 100 ms) and how many happened while shaders were being built, and Building shaders N with the ones being built. When shader stutter shows in red, that stutter came from building shaders, not from a bug. Turn it on or off in Settings → Satronho meter. At the end goes the phone's temperature.

entradas.pregunta: Where is the session history and how do I share a log?
entradas.respuesta: Satronho NX keeps a copy of every session's log, with the date, the build and the game in its name (the 20 newest stay). In Settings → Session history you pick one and share it. To send the newest one right away, use Share log on the Satronho screen or in the summary when a game closes: Android's share menu opens (WhatsApp, Drive, email).

entradas.pregunta: What are the suggested settings?
entradas.respuesta: In Settings → Suggested settings (or the Satronho screen), Satronho looks at your phone (its GPU and RAM) and offers three profiles: Performance, Balanced and Quality, one marked as recommended. Apply changes the resolution, the filter and the graphics accuracy, and turns on asynchronous shaders and the shader cache. You can change any setting by hand afterwards.

entradas.pregunta: Why is my Mali or Tensor phone slow?
entradas.respuesta: Mali GPUs (Google Tensor in Pixels, MediaTek Dimensity, many Exynos) are the hardest for Switch emulation: their drivers perform worse and have more bugs than Snapdragon's Adreno. Lighter Switch games run better; Switch 2 games will most likely be slow. Use the Performance profile from the suggested settings and Prepare game.

entradas.pregunta: Can I install another GPU driver?
entradas.respuesta: Custom drivers (like Turnip) only work on Snapdragon's Adreno GPUs. If your phone has an Adreno, you find it in Settings → GPU driver manager. Mali, Xclipse and Tensor use the system driver.

entradas.pregunta: What is the shader cache?
entradas.respuesta: Every shader the game builds is saved in the cache, so next time it loads at once instead of being built again. That is why a game may stutter the first times and then run smoother. Prepare game moves that work to the loading screen.

entradas.pregunta: Which resolution should I use?
entradas.respuesta: On a phone it is best to start low: 1/2X or 3/4X on most, 1X only on powerful phones. Higher resolution looks sharper but asks more of the GPU. The easiest is to pick a profile in Suggested settings and adjust from there.

entradas.pregunta: What are FSR and the scaling filter?
entradas.respuesta: The scaling filter decides how the image is enlarged to your screen. Bilinear is the lightest. FSR makes it sharper at some performance cost: it is the one in the Quality profile.

entradas.pregunta: Where do I see what's new?
entradas.respuesta: Every new build shows its news when you open the app, tagged New, Improvement and Fix. You can see them again on the Satronho screen (News tab), in Settings → News or from the bubble.

entradas.pregunta: How do I update Satronho NX?
entradas.respuesta: When you open the app, Satronho NX checks its GitHub releases for a new build and offers to download and install it on top, keeping your data and games. You can turn it off in the app settings (Check for updates). You can also download the APK by hand from the releases of the Riddsc/satronho-nx repository.

entradas.pregunta: Why does it ask me to uninstall to install the new one?
entradas.respuesta: Android only installs an app on top when it is signed with the same key. The first previews came out with a test key; since Satronho NX has its own key, that preview has to be uninstalled once. After that, every build installs on top.

entradas.pregunta: How do I change the app's language?
entradas.respuesta: By default the app uses your phone's language. In Settings → App language you pick the phone's, Español or English. The guides and the Android news answer in the app's language.

entradas.pregunta: What is the Satronho screen?
entradas.respuesta: It is Satronho NX's hub, like the desktop's Satronho window: News, Suggested settings, Ask the guides and Guides, in tabs. Open it from Settings → Satronho (first in the list), by long-pressing the guides' bubble, or by long-pressing the app icon → Satronho.

entradas.pregunta: What is the summary when a game closes?
entradas.respuesta: When you leave a game after playing at least half a minute, Troya shows how long you played, the average FPS and in the slowest moments, the stutters and how many came from shaders, and the longest one. If almost all came from shaders and the game isn't prepared, Samy offers to prepare it. You can share the log from there too. Turn it off with Don't show again or in Settings → Summary when a game closes.

entradas.pregunta: What do the ✓ and the fps on the game cards mean?
entradas.respuesta: It is Satronho's mark on each game: ✓ (green) means it is already prepared, and the number is the average FPS of its last session. The list view also shows how many stutters it had.

entradas.pregunta: What shows up when I long-press the app icon?
entradas.respuesta: Long-pressing the Satronho NX icon shows the last games you opened, to jump straight in, and Satronho, which opens the Satronho screen. You can drag any of them to your home screen. On Android 13 or newer, with themed icons on, the Satronho planet takes your wallpaper's colors.

entradas.pregunta: What is the game page?
entradas.respuesta: Long-pressing a game opens its page: the time you've played it in Satronho NX, how many sessions, the last one's FPS and stutters, a chart of the last sessions' FPS, and buttons to Play, Prepare game, Back up saves and open its properties.

entradas.pregunta: How do I back up my saves?
frases: saves from the pc to the phone
entradas.respuesta: On the game's page (long-press it) → Back up saves, or Settings → Back up every save for all your games at once: Satronho packs the saves into a .zip and opens the share menu (Drive, WhatsApp, your PC). That .zip also works in Satronho NX on PC: the game's Ficha Satronho → Restaurar…. The other way round, the PC's .zip imports here in the game's properties → Save data → Import. Do it before uninstalling the app, because uninstalling deletes them.

entradas.pregunta: How do I take a Satronho capture?
entradas.respuesta: Open the game menu (swipe from the edge or press back) → Satronho capture. The game's picture is saved with a discreet band showing our planet, Satronho NX, the game and its FPS, in Pictures → Satronho NX, and the share menu opens.

entradas.pregunta: Why does performance drop when the phone gets hot?
entradas.respuesta: The meter shows the battery's temperature: teal normal, amber warm and red from 42 °C. That hot, the phone (especially the Pixels' Tensor) slows itself down to cool off and FPS drop. When it happens I tell you in the summary and offer a lighter profile. Taking the case off and not playing while charging helps.

entradas.pregunta: How does Ñoño tune a single game?
entradas.respuesta: If a game runs below 25 FPS two sessions in a row, in the summary I offer to lower its resolution one step, just for that game (in its own settings), without touching the others. You can undo it in its properties → Per-game settings.

entradas.pregunta: How do I change the theme and the controls' style?
entradas.respuesta: In Satronho → Style tab: the app theme (Violet, Night in pure black for OLED screens, or Amber), the on-screen controls' style (Satronho violet, Classic grey or Nearly transparent) and how visible the planet behind the games is.

entradas.pregunta: How do I add the Satronho widget to my home screen?
entradas.respuesta: Long-press an empty spot on your home screen → Widgets → Satronho NX · Continue. It shows your last game, how it went and a button to keep playing.

entradas.pregunta: What does the carousel view have?
entradas.respuesta: With the view button (top, next to the filter) you pick grid, list or carousel. In Satronho's carousel, the centered game's art shows blurred in the background, and above it go its name, whether it is prepared, its last session's FPS, the time played and the Play and Page buttons. The carousel is used with the phone upright.
